name: jev
description: Runs jev-gateway for Claude Code from inside the session: Jev picks the next tool on each request, shown live, measured against a baseline

gateway.title: Jev: route through jev-gateway
gateway.description: on: the mod starts jev-gateway and sends this session's model requests through it (straight to the API again the moment it stops answering). off: requests go straight to the API.

port.title: Jev: gateway port
port.description: The local port the mod runs jev-gateway on (127.0.0.1 only).

excludedRepos.title: Jev: excluded repos
excludedRepos.description: Comma-separated folder names. Sessions in these folders never go through the gateway, so their conversations are not sent to Jev.
